name: rhize-ops
description: Operations skill set for delegation, hand-offs, and team workflow automation. Houses delegate-to-teammate (package a session's work into a structured hand-off for a configured teammate — tracker issue + Slack notification + Fireflies context). Recipient identity, tracker IDs, and project mapping are set up via /rhize-ops:delegate-setup and stored in a local config outside the repo, not hardcoded.
